description: Combat Support Arms provide essential firepower, engineering, signals communications, air defense, and battlefield aviation support.

items.name: Regiment of Artillery
items.motto: Sarvatra Izzat-o-Iqbal (Everywhere with Honour and Glory)
items.role: God of War — delivers lethal, long-range fire support using howitzers (K9 Vajra, M777, Dhanush, Bofors) and rocket systems (Pinaka, Smerch).
items.details: Ensures artillery supremacy to suppress, neutralize, and destroy enemy installations ahead of ground advances.

items.name: Corps of Engineers
items.role: Combat engineering including assault bridging, minefield breaching, tracks building, demolition, and bomb disposal.
items.details: Comprises Bombay Sappers, Bengal Sappers, Madras Sappers, and Military Engineer Services (MES).

items.name: Corps of Signals
items.role: Manages battlefield telecommunications, cyber security, command network infrastructure, and electronic warfare.
items.details: Ensures seamless communication between field commanders, tactical headquarters, and fighting units.

items.name: Army Air Defence (AAD)
items.motto: Akashe Shatrun Jahi (Destroy the Enemy in the Sky)
items.role: Protects tactical battle areas and vital military assets from low to medium altitude air attacks.
items.details: Employs surface-to-air missile systems (Akash, L70, ZSU-23-4 Shilka, Igla MANPADS).

items.name: Army Aviation Corps
items.role: Provides tactical air transport, reconnaissance, search and rescue (SAR), and close air support.
items.details: Flies HAL Prachand Light Combat Helicopters, Rudra, Dhruv ALH, and Cheetah/Chetak helicopters in high-altitude zones like Siachen.
